description: Runs ASR models exported to ONNX through the onnx-asr library. This fighter runs the NVIDIA NeMo Citrinet-512 acoustic model for lang 'en', mirrored to onnx-asr format by OpenVoiceOS from the neongeckocom Citrinet exports (compare against the ovos-stt-plugin-citrinet fighter for the same underlying weights on a different runtime).
notes: Repo verified present on HuggingFace via HfApi (OpenVoiceOS mirror of the neongeckocom Citrinet-512 export, onnx-asr-compatible).
